Jagannath Rath Yatra Celebrated with Large Gatherings

The Jagannath Rath Yatra festival was observed with significant public participation in multiple locations. In Attapur, ISKCON organized its fifth Rath Yatra. In Alirajpur, the event saw a large turnout of devotees, with local officials, including the Collector and SP, participating by pulling the chariot.
